# veyderm

> veyderm is an AI dermatology platform built in the UAE. AI supports every step of dermatology — case assessment, product intelligence, treatment planning and patient care — with a licensed dermatologist reviewing and approving every output before it reaches a patient.

veyderm runs three products on one clinical AI core. The guiding principle across all of them: AI prepares; a licensed dermatologist reviews and approves every output.

## Products
- **veyderm Clinical** — the professional platform for dermatologists: AI search by product, ingredient or concern; AI-drafted treatment plans built around each case; authorised product matching from verified UAE distributors; secure patient communication. The dermatologist reviews, adjusts and approves every plan.
- **Sena** — the AI skin companion for patients, on WhatsApp and in partner stores: understands skin concerns in conversation, analyses photos, and guides patients using a dermatologist-approved plan. Sena provides guidance, not a medical diagnosis.
- **veyderm Partners** — AI insight for skincare and pharmaceutical brands into how dermatology prescribes: prescribing trends, demand signals, and a compliant, brand-neutral channel to reach verified dermatologists. Ranking is never paid placement.
